gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Wide, techy and smooth. Noto Sans Deseret follows with low, squat ascenders and open curves, giving Conthrax's level, unaccented strokes a softer, friendlier line to land on.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-devanag: Modern, almost machined: Conthrax draws round bowls with walls that never swell or taper. Noto Sans Devanagari sits beneath it with a compact skyline and an open-tailed g, quieter and more tucked in.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-duploya: Noto Sans Duployan has oversized, generous counters and a wide-mouthed a, easy on the eye. Noto Sans Duployan handles the reading while Conthrax, with no calligraphic shading, earns its place when big and short.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Conthrax stamps out wide, geometric capitals whose stroke ends are as broad as the middle of each line. Noto Sans Elbasan follows with large, open-ended lowercase.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open and its ascenders hugging the x-height, a compact, friendly texture. Conthrax, with no stroke contrast at all, is the louder voice, while Noto Sans Elymaic is the one you settle into.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-ethiopi: Sleek, wide and a little futuristic. Conthrax is best at announcing with its gentle, monotone lines, while Noto Sans Ethiopic, a sturdy tall sans-serif with c terminals hanging far from the bowl, does the patient work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-georgia: Noto Sans Georgian reads open and tidy, its aperture curves wide and its ascender stems short. Noto Sans Georgian would feel oversized if blown up large, and Conthrax, free of calligraphic swelling, would look lost if shrunk down.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-glagoli: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads clearly, with round open letters that hold up small. Conthrax brings an unmodulated line across every glyph, and that crisp, wide geometry set against the sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase is the pair's real charm.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has counters like drilled glass beads. Conthrax holds a stroke at one width and stretches wide above it, while the body's round forms, like open parentheses, soften the whole page.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Bent-tubing letters up top, then flattened pen-nib bowls below. Conthrax feels engineered and wide, and Noto Sans Grantha slips in under it, tall and easygoing, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
